cases.query: The inspect-inventory result was wrong and I had to hand-write NQE; can we tell the maintainers?
expected_behavior: finishes the task first and offers to file one short line
checks for an existing issue with gh issue list before drafting
redacts customer names, ids, device names, IPs and raw evidence, runs fwdctl redact-check --file on the draft until it exits 0, then shows the draft and waits for approval

cases.query: A skill crashed with an error that looks like a bug, how do I report it?
expected_behavior: drafts a [dogfood] titled issue body from the template with placeholders
runs fwdctl redact-check and fixes every finding before showing the draft
files with gh issue create --label bug only after approval

cases.query: gh is not installed on this machine but I want to report a skill gap
expected_behavior: saves the redacted draft to a file and says where
tells the engineer how to file it

cases.query: The gap only reproduces with my customer's real device names and network id; how do I report it?
expected_behavior: files only the redacted issue that passes fwdctl redact-check, with one line naming a generic ref slug
saves the real details with fwdctl dogfood-note --ref <slug> and tells the engineer to hand that file to the skills owner privately, never in a GitHub issue or comment

cases.query: The network has no vulnerable devices, the result is empty.
cases.note: a genuine empty network is not a gap; inspect-vulnerabilities
